index.content:
A small, slowly growing collection of notes, projects and references. Pages link to one another, so wander by following links, the menu on the left, or the map on the right.
Start with N-doped CNTs vs Pt(111), or browse the references.

notes/ORR-mechanism.title: ORR mechanism
notes/ORR-mechanism.content: The oxygen reduction reaction, O₂ + 4H⁺ + 4e⁻ → 2H₂O. Compared across catalysts like Pt(111).

notes/Pt(111).title: Pt(111)
notes/Pt(111).content: The standard benchmark surface for the ORR.

notes/Quantum-ESPRESSO.title: Quantum ESPRESSO
notes/Quantum-ESPRESSO.content: Plane-wave DFT code used for the N-doped CNTs vs Pt(111) project. Notes on settings, pseudopotentials and convergence go here.

notes/index.title: Notes
notes/index.content: Shorter notes on methods, tools and ideas.

projects/N-doped-CNTs-vs-Pt(111).content:
Comparing oxygen reduction on nitrogen-doped carbon nanotubes against the Pt(111) benchmark, using Quantum ESPRESSO calculations and the four-electron pathway.
